item.title: Mexican army kills leader of powerful cartel during operation to capture him
item.description: The Mexican army killed the leader of the Jalisco New Generation Cartel, “El Mencho,” decapitating what had become Mexico's most powerful cartel and giving the government its biggest prize yet to show the Trump administration its efforts.
